_comment: Minimum screenshot inventory F8's morning-review doc must reference AND that must actually exist on disk under contracts/checks/ticketing-complete-f8/screenshots/ -- mirrors the existing screenshot convention already used by contracts/checks/vendor-form-*-f1/screenshots/. Each entry is a required substring the doc's markdown must contain as part of an image reference, not a literal filename mandate -- the check script resolves whatever path the doc actually names and confirms the file exists, rather than requiring these exact names.
